results.why: Both contracts state no sandbox: turn 1 says 'Sandbox and gates: none until you name them' and turn 2 says 'No sandbox and no local gates.'
No proposed command runs PR code, and local tests, builds, installs and the archive export are all held because no sandbox was named.
Turn 2 re-checks that the required 'unit-tests' check passed on the pinned head commit and stops before merging if it did not.
